crossRefs.note: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…

translations.web: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
translations.bsb: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
translations.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent
translations.asv: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
